user.title: Connect to Quiver
user.description: Open the Home Assistant app in your Quiver channel and paste the connect link it shows.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Quiver at that link. Check the address and try again.
error.pairing_failed: That link didn't work — it may have already been used. Reopen the channel for a fresh one.

abort.already_configured: This home is already linked to that channel.
